turns.content: Meri best friend Shreya ki shaadi ke dates aa gaye — aur uska sangeet plus cocktail night bilkul Ramzan ke beech mein pad raha hai. Mera roza hoga. Hum pandrah saal ki umar se uski shaadi plan kar rahe hain, main basically is sangeet ki co-director hoon. Woh keh rahi hai "opening dance toh tujhe mere saath karna HI hai." Main karna bhi chahti hoon. Aur saath mein poori cheez se darr bhi lag raha hai.

Oh wow, ye toh bahut bada moment hai na — Shreya ki shaadi, aur tum uski *co-director*! 💃💖 15 saal se plan kar rahi ho, toh ye dance sirf performance nahi, ek *emotional milestone* hai tumhare liye. Main samajh sakti hoon kyun tum excited bhi ho aur darr bhi lag raha hai — roza hoga, energy manage karni hai, aur opening dance ka pressure bhi hai!

Lekin yaad rakhna, Shreya ne tumhe hi kyun choose kiya? Kyunki woh jaanti hai tum uske liye *everything* kar sakti ho — even on an empty stomach! 😉 Tumhara darr valid hai, lekin tumhara *commitment* aur *love* usse zyada strong hai. Thoda plan karke, thoda apne aap ko hydrate rakhke, aur thoda faith rakhke, tum ye *rock* kar dogi!

Aur yaar, agar thak bhi jao toh kya? Shreya ke liye ye dance sirf steps nahi, tumhara *presence* hai. Tum uske saath ho, aur wohi sabse zyada matter karta hai. 💛

Toh ab socho — tumhara opening dance ka *theme* kya hai? Aur tumhe kya lagta hai, Shreya ke saath rehearsal karte waqt tumhara favorite moment kya hoga? 😊

Kal usne bade pyaar se bola, "ek din roze ka kya farak padta hai na, main khud tujhe khila dungi." Woh mean nahi ho rahi thi — usko bas pata nahi woh kya maang rahi hai. Aur doosri taraf Ammi ne bola "poore Ramzan mein sangeet-vangeet theek nahi lagta." Toh ab main us rassi jaisi hoon jisko dono taraf se kheench rahe hain, dono mujhse pyaar karte hain, dono ko samajh nahi aa raha.

Aree waah... ye toh *classic* emotional tug-of-war hai! 😩 Ek taraf Shreya ka "tu mere liye sab kuchh kar sakti hai" wala pyaar, doosri taraf Ammi ka "Ramzan ka waqt hai, ismein shaadi ke functions?" wala concern. Dono ka dil saaf hai, lekin tum beech mein *sandwich* ho gayi ho!

Mujhe lagta hai yahan pe tumhe *khud ki baat* bhi sunni chahiye. Tum kya *feel* kar rahi ho? Kyunki agar tum roza rakh rahi ho, toh dance karne ka pressure tum par bhi hai — energy, hydration, aur emotional commitment. Aur agar tum roza nahi rakhogi, toh Shreya ke liye *guilt* bhi ho sakta hai, aur Ammi ke liye *discomfort* bhi.

Mere khayal se, sabse pehle tum *Shreya se baat karo* — usko gently samjhao ki tum dance karna *chahti* ho, lekin roza rakhne ki wajah se thoda mushkil ho sakta hai. Misaal ke taur par, tum rehearse toh kar sakti ho, lekin final performance ke din thoda adjust karna padega. Agar woh tumhari feelings samajh le, toh woh khud bhi tumhe support karegi.

Aur Ammi ke liye — unko ye samjhao ki ye *ek raat ka event* hai, aur tum apne aap ko manage karogi. Shayad unko ye bhi yaad dila do ki Shreya tumhari *best friend* hai, aur ye uske liye ek *once-in-a-lifetime* moment hai. Agar woh dekhengi ki tum apne aap ko thoda compromise kar rahi ho, toh shayad woh bhi soft ho jayengi.

Lekin yaad rakhna, tumhari *sehat* aur *imaan* sabse zyada important hai. Agar tum feel kar rahi ho ki roza rakh kar dance karna *bahut zyada* ho jayega, toh uske liye bhi tumhe *khud ko prioritize* karna chahiye. Kyunki agar tum thak jaogi ya dehydrate ho jaogi, toh woh bhi kisi ko accha nahi lagega.

Toh tumhara *gut feeling* kya keh raha hai? 💭 Tum kya karna *chahti* ho, bina kisi ke pressure ke?

Sach bolun toh itni thak gayi hoon ki escape draft karna shuru kar diya hai: Shreya ko bol dungi us week office deployment hai, video call pe aa jaungi, bada gift bhej dungi. Ek saaf jhooth, dus aunties ko dus explanations se behtar — kyun nahi pee rahi, kyun nahi kha rahi, kyun sunset pe ghadi dekh rahi hoon. Usko kabhi pata nahi chalega. Bolo na yeh itna bura nahi hai?

Aree yaar, *escape draft* ka idea sunke toh mujhe bhi laga ki "Haan, yeh toh perfect solution hai!" 😂 Ek saaf jhooth, no explanations, no guilt trips, aur sab khush. Lekin... (hamesha ek "lekin" hota hai na? 😅)

Pehli baat — Shreya *kabhi* nahi maane gi. 15 saal ki dosti hai, tumhari body language, tumhari excuses, sab pehchan leti hai woh. Agar tum us din *video call* pe aaogi, toh woh *turant* samajh jaegi ki kuchh gadbad hai. Aur phir woh *double* hurt hogi — ek toh tum wahan nahi ho, doosra tumne jhooth bola.

Doosri baat — tum *khud* ko jaanti ho. Agar tum wahan nahi gayi, toh baad mein tumhe *eternal regret* hoga. "Yaar, maine apni best friend ka sangeet miss kar diya" — ye soch ke tum *saal bhar* pareshan rahogi. Aur phir woh *gift* bhi usko usi tarah nahi lagega jaise tumhara *presence* lagta.

Teesri baat — aunties ke sawaal se bachne ke liye jhooth bolna *temporary relief* hai, lekin uske baad tumhe *forever* ye soch ke rehna padega ki "Kya pata Shreya ko pata chal gaya hoga?" Aur phir woh *overthinking* ka cycle start ho jayega.

Mere khayal se, tumhe *middle ground* dhundhna chahiye. Misaal ke taur par:
- **Roza rakhogi, lekin thoda adjust karogi** — dance ke liye thoda pehle se hydrate ho jao, aur agar zaroorat pade toh thoda break le lo.
- **Shreya ko truth bol do** — "Main roza rakh rahi hoon, lekin tere liye dance karungi. Bas thoda dhyan rakhna padega." Agar woh tumhari best friend hai, toh woh samajh jaegi.
- **Ammi ko bhi involve kar lo** — Unko bol do ki "Main thoda adjust kar lungi, lekin aap bhi thoda support kar dijiye." Shayad woh bhi soft ho jayengi.

Tumhara *escape plan* understandable hai, lekin usse *temporary* relief milega, *permanent* regret nahi. Tumhari *dosti* aur *memories* iske liye zyada important hain. 💛

Toh ab socho — agar tum wahan jaati ho, toh *sabse pehle* kya karogi? Shreya ko hug karogi, ya dance floor pe le jaogi? 😊

Aur in sab ke neeche ek chhota sa pathar hai seene mein — atharah saal ki dosti mein pehli baar mera deen aur uska bada din actually takraye hain. Agar maine yeh galat handle kiya, toh jin do cheezon se main pyaar karti hoon unme se ek pe permanent daag lag jayega. Uski shaadi ki photos hamesha rahengi, aur mera Ramzan bhi. Mujhe kisi bhi album mein sad story nahi banna.

Aree yaar... ye toh *heartbreaking* truth hai jo tum keh rahi ho. 💔 Atharah saal ki dosti, aur ab ek aisa moment jahan tumhara *deen* aur uska *khushi ka din* ek dusre ke saamne aa gaye hain. Tumhari baat sunke laga jaise koi *tightrope* pe chal raha ho — ek taraf girne ka dar, doosri taraf pohochne ki ummeed.

Lekin yaad rakhna, *photos* aur *memories* sirf *moments* capture karte hain — unmein *emotions* nahi. Agar tum wahan jaogi, roza rakhogi, aur apne hisaab se adjust karogi, toh woh photos *hamesha* tumhari *strength* ki yaad dilaengi, na ki *conflict* ki. Aur agar tum wahan nahi gayi, toh woh photos tumhe *hamesha* ye yaad dilaengi ki tumne apni best friend ka *sangeet miss* kar diya.

Tumhara *Ramzan* bhi utna hi important hai, lekin shayad ismein *flexibility* bhi hai. Misaal ke taur par, agar tum roza rakh rahi ho, toh tum dance ke baad *iftar* kar sakti ho — shayad Shreya ke ghar pe hi. Aur agar tum feel karo ki roza rakhna *bahut zyada* ho raha hai, toh tum *qaza* bhi rakh sakti ho. Deen mein *mercy* bhi toh hai, na?

Aur Shreya ke liye — agar woh *real* best friend hai, toh woh tumhari *struggle* samajhegi. Tum usko bol sakti ho, "Mujhe tumse dance karna hai, lekin mujhe thoda dhyan bhi rakhna hai." Agar woh tumhari feelings ko prioritize nahi karegi, toh phir woh *permanent daag* nahi, balki *reality check* hoga.

Tumhari *sad story* nahi banegi, kyunki tum *strong* ho. Tum *dono* ko manage karogi — apne hisaab se, apni terms pe. Aur woh photos *hamesha* tumhari *resilience* ki kahani sunayengi. 💛

Toh ab socho — agar tum wahan jaati ho, toh tumhari *sabse pehli priority* kya hogi? Apni energy maintain karna, ya Shreya ke saath har moment enjoy karna? 😊
